_status: Module 3, Lesson 3.3 'Roles, not people': joiner, mover, leaver (learner guide of 21 October 2026), including contract-of-service and job-order staff and consultants; case 4 is Try it 3.3 question 3. Fictional office.

items.text: A job-order staff member starts on Monday as a records clerk.

facts.v: Access is set up on the first day: a named account with the records clerk role only, and MFA

items.reason: The rule covers contract-of-service and job-order staff and consultants too.

items.text: Ben moves from records to the cashier unit next week.

facts.v: On the day he moves: the records clerk role is removed and the cashier role added

items.reason: If his old role stays, one person could encode an application and release its payout.

items.text: A consultant's contract ends on Friday.

facts.v: Every account, including the VPN, is closed on the last day

items.reason: Module 2's contractor could still connect two months after leaving.

items.text: A records clerk is promoted to supervisor.

facts.v: Her clerk access is removed on the day she moves

items.reason: So she cannot encode and approve the same application (Try it 3.3, question 3).
